mapper.select: select last_event_seq from aden_workspace where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and workspace_status='ACTIVE' for update

select workspace_id,runner_id,runner_name,runner_presence,capabilities_json,current_session_epoch,current_credential_epoch,version,created_by_ruoyi_user_id,created_at,updated_at from aden_runner where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and runner_id=#{runnerId} for update

select workspace_id,credential_id,runner_id,credential_epoch,credential_keyed_digest,pepper_key_id,credential_status,issued_at,expires_at from aden_runner_credential where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and credential_id=#{credentialId} for update

select workspace_id,credential_id,runner_id,credential_epoch,credential_keyed_digest,pepper_key_id,credential_status,issued_at,expires_at from aden_runner_credential where credential_id=#{credentialId} limit 2

select s.workspace_id,s.session_id,s.runner_id,s.credential_id,s.session_status,s.session_epoch,s.session_keyed_digest,s.pepper_key_id,s.capacity,s.in_flight,s.heartbeat_sequence,s.heartbeat_at,s.expires_at,r.current_session_epoch runner_current_session_epoch from aden_runner_session s join aden_runner r on r.workspace_id=s.workspace_id and r.runner_id=s.runner_id where s.session_id=#{sessionId} limit 2
mapper.update: update aden_runner set current_session_epoch=#{nextEpoch},runner_presence='ONLINE',last_seen_at=#{now},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and runner_id=#{runnerId} and current_session_epoch=#{expectedEpoch} and version=#{expectedVersion} and runner_presence<>'QUARANTINED'
update aden_runner_session set session_status='SUPERSEDED',version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and runner_id=#{runnerId} and session_status='ACTIVE'
update aden_runner set runner_presence='QUARANTINED',version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and runner_id=#{runnerId} and version=#{expectedVersion}

update aden_runner_credential set credential_status='REVOKED',revoked_at=#{now},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and runner_id=#{runnerId} and credential_status='ACTIVE'
update aden_runner_session set session_status='REVOKED',version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and runner_id=#{runnerId} and session_status='ACTIVE'
update aden_workspace set last_event_seq=#{next},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} where workspace_id=#{workspaceId} and last_event_seq=#{expected} and workspace_status='ACTIVE'
